artifact:
Feature: Doorstop Requirements Management

  Scenario: Doorstop provides unique and permanent identifiers to linkable sections of text
    Given a new requirement is added to Doorstop
    When the requirement is saved
    Then the requirement shall have a unique and permanent identifier

  Scenario Outline: Doorstop supports formatting within linkable text
    Given a requirement with text "<text>" is added to Doorstop
    When the requirement is saved
    Then the requirement text shall be formatted as "<formatted_text>"

    Examples:
      | text                  | formatted_text          |
      | *Bold Text*           | **Bold Text**           |
      | _Italic Text_         | *Italic Text*           |
      | `Code Text`           | `Code Text`             |
      | [Link](http://url)    | [Link](http://url)      |

  Scenario: Doorstop supports the storage of external requirements assets
    Given an external asset file "external_asset.txt" is provided
    When the asset is stored in Doorstop
    Then the asset shall be stored and accessible in Doorstop

  Scenario: Doorstop can import content from other requirements management tools
    Given a requirements file "requirements.csv" from another tool is provided
    When the file is imported into Doorstop
    Then the requirements from the file shall be imported into Doorstop

  Scenario: Doorstop can export content to interact with common text/document tools
    Given requirements are stored in Doorstop
    When the requirements are exported to a file "requirements.docx"
    Then the requirements shall be exported to "requirements.docx" in a compatible format

  Scenario: Doorstop provides a way to view requirements as a document
    Given requirements are stored in Doorstop
    When the requirements are viewed as a document
    Then the requirements shall be displayed in a document format

  Scenario: Doorstop provides a way to view document items interactively
    Given requirements are stored in Doorstop
    When the requirements are viewed interactively
    Then the requirements shall be displayed in an interactive format

  Scenario: Doorstop provides the capability to baseline versions of requirements
    Given requirements are stored in Doorstop
    When a baseline is created for the requirements
    Then the baseline version of the requirements shall be stored and accessible in Doorstop
